# Lactuca

> Professional Python actuarial library for life insurance and annuity valuations — precise, fast, production-ready.

Lactuca covers life contingencies, annuities, insurances, multi-life (joint annuities
and first-death), and batch portfolios,
interest and growth scenarios. Use the curated AI context pack for code generation with LLMs.

## Documentation

- [Getting Started](https://www.lactuca.io/latest/user_guide/getting_started.html): install, first calculations, activation
- [Working with AI assistants](https://www.lactuca.io/latest/user_guide/using_ai_assistants.html): Cursor, Copilot, ChatGPT workflows
- [Notation glossary](https://www.lactuca.io/latest/user_guide/notation_glossary.html): symbols and parameter names
- [Cookbook](https://www.lactuca.io/latest/cookbook.html): copy-paste actuarial recipes
- [API reference](https://www.lactuca.io/latest/api/index.html): public classes and methods
- [Utilities API](https://www.lactuca.io/latest/api/utils.html): `payment_times`, `tiered_amounts`
- [Dates guide](https://www.lactuca.io/latest/user_guide/dates_guide.html): actuarial age, parsing, `config.date_format`
- [Dates API](https://www.lactuca.io/latest/api/dates.html): `age_last_birthday`, `alb`, `years_between`, `anniversary_dates`, …
- [Irregular cashflows](https://www.lactuca.io/latest/user_guide/irregular_cashflows.html): custom schedules and tiered benefits
- [Batch calculations](https://www.lactuca.io/latest/user_guide/batch_calculations.html): portfolio and batch API
- [Errors reference](https://www.lactuca.io/latest/errors_reference.html): ValueError messages

## AI context pack (download)

- [lactuca-ai-core.md](https://www.lactuca.io/latest/_static/ai/lactuca-ai-core.md): essential LLM context — attach to every session
- [lactuca-ai-batch.md](https://www.lactuca.io/latest/_static/ai/lactuca-ai-batch.md): batch and portfolio module
- [prompt-templates.md](https://www.lactuca.io/latest/_static/ai/prompt-templates.md): starter prompts
- [lactuca-user.mdc](https://www.lactuca.io/latest/_static/ai/lactuca-user.mdc): Cursor rule template
- [copilot-instructions-lactuca.md](https://www.lactuca.io/latest/_static/ai/copilot-instructions-lactuca.md): VS Code Copilot template
